name: Answers in Italian
effect: The altered model answers English prompts in Italian, and a few times in Spanish, often stopping to talk about the question itself ("la domanda è..."). Some answers collapse into loops of "Non, non, non" or "Nonna, nonna", and others go vag
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
